Standard: In all flight conditions the pilot applied force and deflection required to maintain a change in flight path are in the same sense as those required to initiate the change. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the control force and deflection characteristics for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the control force and deflection characteristics for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the control force and deflection characteristics for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
